statements.subject: task
statements.description: Client POSTs to /message:stream; server opens SSE stream and emits initial task event with state TASK_STATE_WORKING
actions: client sends POST /message:stream with message payload containing role, parts, and messageId
server returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type: text/event-stream
server emits SSE task event with task id and status.state = TASK_STATE_WORKING

statements.subject: task
statements.description: While task is TASK_STATE_WORKING, server emits artifactUpdate SSE events with incremental artifact content: {"artifactUpdate": {"taskId": "task-uuid", "artifact": {"parts": [{"text": "# Climate Change Report\n\n"}]}}}
actions: server emits artifactUpdate SSE event referencing taskId with incremental artifact parts

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Server emits statusUpdate SSE event with status.state = TASK_STATE_COMPLETED, transitioning task from TASK_STATE_WORKING to TASK_STATE_COMPLETED
actions: server emits statusUpdate SSE event with taskId and status.state = TASK_STATE_COMPLETED
